task:
Goal: prove an app can be opened by name and quit.
Apps: Calculator only. Do not touch any other app or window, never focus Google Chrome, and do not use the Dock, Spotlight or Launchpad.
You may: call cua.getApp("Calculator") (this may launch it), read its window title from the accessibility tree, take one screenshot with emit enabled, then quit Calculator with the Command+Q key press inside Calculator only. No other clicks or typing.
Report: the window title you read and whether the quit was confirmed. A read after quitting that returns 'App quit' is the confirmation, not an error.
